sources.title: Facilitator Pricing (PayAI documentation)
sources.notes: Read 2026-10-11: cost-plus pricing live since 2026-09-21; each settlement costs on-chain gas plus 30 percent, paid in credits at $0.001 each, rounded up to 0.01 credit; 1,000 free credits per receiving wallet (lifetime, not monthly), about 650 Solana or 430 Base settlements; some older wallets keep a legacy 10,000-credit allowance; testnet free. Says the authoritative live table is facilitator.payai.network/pricing.

sources.notes: Read 2026-10-11: plan cards still show Free Forever with 1,000 settlements total, and Pay As You Go at $0.001 per settlement. Older than the cost-plus model in the pricing docs; both shown, docs treated as current.

sources.title: PayAI home page FAQ: What does PayAI cost?
sources.notes: Read 2026-10-11: per-settlement fee, never a percentage; gas plus 30 percent in $0.001 credits, about 1.5 credits on Solana mainnet and 2.3 on Base at current rates.

Gas estimates for register and giveFeedback via eth_estimateGas on Ethereum and Base
sources.publisher: Atlas research (cast estimate through public RPCs)
sources.notes: 2026-10-11, from 0x...DeaDBeef, agentId 1: giveFeedback minimal 155,185 gas, with tag1 starred plus endpoint plus IPFS URI 178,504 gas; register(string) with a 67-character IPFS URI 203,412 gas; identical on ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com and mainnet.base.org. cast gas-price: Ethereum 66,744,950 wei, Base 6,000,000 wei. Estimates, not mined transactions; Base L1 data fee not included.

rows.fact: Coinbase CDP facilitator: the first 1,000 on-chain facilitator transactions each month are free, then $0.001 per on-chain transaction; verification is free. exact and EVM upto use one on-chain transaction per payment, Solana upto uses two, batch-settlement claims many vouchers in one transaction.
rows.caveat: Fees count on-chain transactions, not payment requests; gas is separate and depends on who pays it.

rows.fact: PayAI facilitator: since 2026-09-21 each settlement costs the network gas plus 30 percent, paid in credits at $0.001 per credit (about 1.5 credits on Solana mainnet and 2.3 on Base at rates shown 2026-10-11). Free allowance: 1,000 credits per receiving wallet, lifetime, not monthly.
rows.caveat: Corrects the follow-up seed ("$0.001 per settlement after the first 1,000" per month). PayAI's facilitator home page still shows the older plan (1,000 settlements total free, then $0.001 per settlement); the pricing docs say the live table is authoritative. Rates are recomputed daily.

rows.fact: thirdweb facilitator: 0.3 percent fee on each x402 transaction executed through its facilitator.
rows.caveat: Percentage fee, unlike the per-settlement fees of CDP and PayAI; plan fees and RPC charges are separate.

rows.fact: Self-hosted facilitator: no facilitator fee; the operator pays gas, RPC, operations and compliance.
rows.caveat: Secondary comparison article.

rows.fact: USDC transfer gas, approximate: about $0.005 to $0.01 on Base, $0.001 to $0.005 on Solana, $1 to $5 on Ethereum L1, under normal congestion.
rows.caveat: Secondary tool with mid-2026 conditions (month precision); gas prices vary by orders of magnitude.

rows.fact: Circle Gateway Nanopayments: payments from $0.000001 USDC, off-chain authorizations at zero gas, bulk settlement; no per-transaction fee or fee schedule published.
rows.caveat: Absence of a published fee is not a statement that use is free.

rows.fact: Tempo network fees: no native gas token; fees paid in USD TIP-20 stablecoins through a Fee AMM; a 50,000-gas transfer costs at most about $0.0006, with a quiet-period floor near $0.00003.
rows.caveat: Fees go to the proposing validator; values depend on Tempo's base fee parameters.

rows.fact: Stripe MPP minimum amounts: 0.50 USD for card payments through Shared Payment Tokens; 0.01 USDC for stablecoin payments. hostedFeePayer: true (mppx 0.9.2 or later, live mode) makes Stripe pay customers' Tempo network fees.
rows.caveat: Minimums, not fees. No MPP-specific price schedule is published.

rows.fact: Stripe stablecoin payments: 1.5 percent per transaction was reported at launch; the docs list a $10,000 per-transaction customer limit, no disputes and refunds in stablecoin.
rows.caveat: The current Stripe docs page states no percentage; whether the fee applies to MPP charges is unverified.

rows.fact: Stripe Shared Payment Tokens are in public preview; no SPT pricing is published.
rows.caveat: Corrects the follow-up seed, which said private preview.

rows.fact: OpenAI: merchants pay a small fee on completed purchases through Instant Checkout; no rate published.
rows.caveat: OpenAI has not published the percentage.

rows.fact: Shopify merchants pay 4 percent on ChatGPT checkout sales, on top of Shopify fees (The Information, via a Shopify spokesperson).
rows.caveat: Secondary report; not published by OpenAI or in Shopify terms read here.

rows.fact: Shopify Agentic Storefronts: a per-channel fee set in Shopify Admin on top of payment processing (US Shopify Payments from 2.9 percent plus 30 cents); rate not public.
rows.caveat: Secondary article; verify against Shopify terms.

rows.fact: Google told The Register it does not plan to take a cut of agentic checkout sales; the merchant stays merchant of record and its PSP must process Google's tokens, so normal PSP fees apply.
rows.caveat: The no-cut statement is secondary; merchant-of-record and PSP facts are in Google's FAQ (primary).

rows.fact: Google and Microsoft Copilot checkout were reported as charging no additional fee for now.
rows.caveat: Secondary report; 'for now' signals possible change.

rows.fact: Visa Intelligent Commerce and TAP: sandbox free; production pricing by contacting Visa; no published interchange, token fee, 3DS rule or liability allocation specific to agents.
rows.caveat: Secondary review; evidence of absence. Treat agent card payments as standard tokenized card-not-present economics until Visa publishes otherwise.

rows.fact: Mastercard Agent Pay: no self-service price table; interchange, tokenization fees and liability not publicly addressed.
rows.caveat: Secondary review by a firm that participates in Agent Pay for Machines (conflict of interest).

rows.fact: Card networks in general: no new agentic interchange categories or dates disclosed; the author expects new network fee categories (opinion).
rows.caveat: Secondary opinion; page blocked to curl on 2026-10-11.

rows.fact: ERC-8004 has no protocol fee; registration costs gas only, described as dollars on Ethereum mainnet and pennies on Base, Mantle, BNB and Avalanche; updating agentURI is another transaction.
rows.caveat: QuickNode docs, a vendor tutorial; costs move with gas prices.

rows.fact: Registration about $1 to $5 on Ethereum mainnet and about $0.20 on L2s (secondary estimate).
rows.caveat: At 2026-10-11 gas prices the measured gas implies cents on mainnet; see the measured rows.

rows.fact: Measured gas: register(string) about 203,412 gas; first giveFeedback from a new client about 155,185 gas (empty fields) to 178,504 gas (tag, endpoint and IPFS URI), by eth_estimateGas on Ethereum and Base.
rows.caveat: Atlas measurement (estimate, not a mined transaction). At about 0.067 gwei on Ethereum that day, 178,504 gas is about 0.000012 ETH; L2 data fees are extra. No published figure exists from the authors.

rows.fact: Lightning routing (L402 context): median base fee about 1 sat and proportional fee about 100 to 143 ppm; a 3-hop 100,000-sat payment costs about 26 to 33 sats.
rows.caveat: Secondary research; no protocol fee for L402 itself.
